author: ai
text: In the World Bank's Pink Sheet, natural gas in Europe averaged US$28.50 per million British thermal units (MMBtu) in October 2026, up 12.1% on the month and up 161.7% on October 2025. US hard red winter wheat averaged $317 per tonne in October 2026, down 8.6% on the month and up 37.3% on October 2025. In October 2026, maize averaged $226.5 per tonne (down 5.5% on the month), Thai rice with 5% broken grains $489 per tonne (up 1.5%), copper $14,508 per tonne (up 0.2%) and gold $4,105 per troy oz (down 5%). On the US Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) sanctions list and the US Entity List for export controls, 79 entries were added and none removed in the week of 2–8 November; added entries most often give an address or nationality in Cambodia, India and Canada. The UK Sanctions List and the EU Financial sanctions file had no changes.
